jesus_905.why: The angel told Joseph to name him Jesus, because he would save his people from their sins (Matthew 1).

israel_682.why: Born holding Esau's heel; God later renamed him Israel, 'strives with God,' after he wrestled at Peniel (Genesis 25; 32).

moses_2108.why: Pharaoh's daughter named him because she drew him out of the water (Exodus 2).

abraham_58.why: God changed his name from Abram, 'exalted father,' to Abraham, for he would be father of many nations (Genesis 17).

solomon_2762.why: Named for the peace God promised; Nathan also called him Jedidiah, 'loved by the LORD' (1 Chronicles 22; 2 Samuel 12).

holy_spirit_7400.meaning: 'Spirit' translates words meaning breath or wind

judah_1751.why: Leah named him, saying, 'This time I will praise the LORD' (Genesis 29).

joseph_1710.why: Rachel named him, praying the LORD would add another son (Genesis 30).

peter_2745.why: Jesus said to Simon, 'You shall be called Cephas,' which means Peter, or rock (John 1).

ephraim_1206.why: Joseph named him, saying, 'God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction' (Genesis 41).

benjamin_463.why: Dying Rachel named him Ben-oni, 'son of my sorrow,' but Jacob called him Benjamin (Genesis 35).

esau_1216.why: Born red and hairy, he was named Esau; he was called Edom, 'red,' after the red stew (Genesis 25).

isaac_616.why: Named for laughter: Abraham and Sarah laughed at God's promise, and Sarah said God made her laugh (Genesis 17; 21).

samuel_2469.meaning: Possibly 'name of God' or 'heard by God'
samuel_2469.why: Hannah named him, saying, 'I have asked for him from the LORD' (1 Samuel 1).

manasseh_1928.why: Joseph named him, saying, 'God has made me forget all my hardship and my father's house' (Genesis 41).

john_1676.why: The angel told Zechariah to call him John; when relatives objected, Zechariah wrote, 'His name is John' (Luke 1).

daniel_975.why: Babylon's officials renamed him Belteshazzar; Nebuchadnezzar said it was after the name of his god (Daniel 1; 4).

reuben_2429.why: Leah named him, saying the LORD had seen her misery and now her husband would love her (Genesis 29).

levi_1820.why: Leah named him, hoping, 'Now this time my husband will be attached to me' (Genesis 29).

dan_973.why: Rachel named him, saying God had judged her case, heard her, and given her a son (Genesis 30).

gad_1262.why: Leah named him, saying, 'Good fortune has come' (Genesis 30).

job_1639.meaning: Possibly 'where is the father?' or 'hated one'

gideon_1314.why: After he tore down Baal's altar, he was called Jerubbaal, 'let Baal contend against him' (Judges 6).

naphtali_2149.why: Rachel named him, saying she had wrestled mightily with her sister and prevailed (Genesis 30).

sarah_2473.why: God changed her name from Sarai to Sarah, promising she would become the mother of nations (Genesis 17).

noah_2210.why: Lamech named him, saying this son would bring relief from the toil of the cursed ground (Genesis 5).

zebulun_3002.why: Leah named him, saying God had given her a good gift and now her husband would honor her (Genesis 30).

asher_337.why: Leah named him, saying, 'Happy am I, for women will call me happy' (Genesis 30).

simeon_2741.why: Leah named him, saying the LORD had heard that she was unloved and given her this son (Genesis 29).

issachar_645.why: Leah named him, saying God had given her wages for giving her servant to her husband (Genesis 30).

john_1677.why: Jesus called him and his brother James Boanerges, meaning 'sons of thunder' (Mark 3).

barnabas_1722.why: The apostles called Joseph of Cyprus Barnabas, which means son of encouragement (Acts 4).

adam_78.meaning: Man or humankind; sounds like Hebrew for 'ground'
